key_terms.الْيَوْمَ: The Day (referring to the Day of Judgment)

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the disbelievers submitting on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah As-Saffat, this verse marks the dramatic reversal of the disbelievers' arrogance, transitioning from their denial in worldly life to forced submission (istislam) before Allah's command. Shia exegetes often highlight this as the moment when the 'questioning' (tas'il) becomes inescapable, emphasizing that their eventual humility is not voluntary worship but a compelled acknowledgment of divine authority. This underscores the theme of divine justice where the scales of power shift entirely to God on the Day of Reckoning.
